culprit_citations.quoted_text: Burgess Point Purchaser Corporation | Initial Term Loan (First Lien) | 3M SOFR + 5.25% | Interest Rate 9.19% | Initial Acquisition Date 11/25/2024 | Maturity Date 7/25/2029 | Amortized Cost $4,696,356 | Fair Value $4,206,281; evidence CLI overview accession: 0001193125-26-095711

findings.detail: A filing-derived BDC holding row has an empty accession_number even though the raw filing accession is 0001193125-26-095711.

rationale: C006 requires accession_number for source traceability. The flagged artifact records observed accession_number as empty for a filing-derived BDC row, but the evidence CLI overview for the same raw filing reports accession 0001193125-26-095711 and table 48 row 5 is a concrete SOI position from that filing. The defect is localized to extraction/metadata propagation, not to the raw source.
